responsibility: This file implements GCC’s runtime compiler-parameter subsystem for --param options. It builds the language-independent parameter table from params.def, supports adding target or language-specific parameters before initialization is frozen, validates defaults and user-supplied values against numeric or enumerated domains, performs fuzzy lookup for misspelled parameter names, initializes per-compilation parameter arrays from defaults, and exposes helpers to set explicit or implicit values and to reset subsystem state between compiler runs. Its responsibility is the executable management of parameter metadata and values, as distinct from the declarative parameter list in params.def and the public interface in params.h.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable parameter engine: it instantiates the compiler_params table, expands params.def into runtime metadata arrays, and implements initialization, lookup, validation, and value-setting logic. In contrast, params.def is the declarative master list of parameters, and params.h is the public enum/API and accessor macro interface.
